meta.title: Kampung Sumber Alam · Stay and soak in hot spring water in Cipanas, Garut
meta.desc: Kampung Sumber Alam Resort is a Sundanese village in Cipanas, Garut. You stay in a timber bungalow over a fish pond and soak in natural Mount Guntur hot spring water in your own room.
hero.sub: Kampung Sumber Alam Resort · Cipanas, Garut
video.label: Kampung Sumber Alam seen from the air
pembuka.lead: At the foot of Mount Guntur, natural hot springs have flowed for generations. At Kampung Sumber Alam, that water is piped all the way to the soaking tub in every bungalow bathroom.
cerita.label: A day at Kampung Sumber Alam
cerita.judul: What does a day and a night at Kampung Sumber Alam look like?
cerita.1.isi: Check-in opens at 14.00 WIB in a Lobby of red brick and timber boards, under a tiered ijuk (palm-fibre thatch) roof.
cerita.1.alt: Two guests pull their luggage along a path towards a thatched timber bungalow
cerita.2.judul: A footpath leads you to a room above the balong.
cerita.2.isi: The timber bungalows of Kampung Sumber Alam stand over the balong, the Sundanese word for a fish pond. The footpaths that link one bungalow to the next lead you past gardens and saung (open-sided huts) before you reach your terrace.
cerita.2.alt: A winding timber walkway over a lily-covered balong, seen from the air
cerita.3.judul: Mount Guntur water fills the tub in your room.
cerita.3.isi: A dedicated tap in every bungalow bathroom runs natural hot spring water from Mount Guntur straight into the soaking tub, where you can soak for as long as you like. The best time to soak is as the sun goes down and into the night.
cerita.3.alt: Hot spring water pouring from a stone spout into a soaking pool
cerita.4.judul: The night ends with a shared meal in a saung.
cerita.4.isi: Sundanese dishes made for sharing, such as Nasi Liwet 4 Orang and Nasi Lulun Botram 4 Orang, are served in the restaurant and the saung. The restaurant and room service are open until 21.30 WIB.
cerita.4.alt: A thatched timber saung standing over the balong
cerita.5.isi: Breakfast is included in the room rate. Children can join Melukis Caping (painting a conical farmer's hat) or fish in the balong, and the Kampung Sumber Alam kitchen cooks what they catch.
cerita.5.alt: A lily-covered balong and footpaths between rows of bungalows, seen from above
cerita.6.isi: There is still time for one more soak. Then you head home, lighter than when you arrived.
cerita.6.alt: A fountain in the balong, thatched bungalows, and Mount Guntur in the distance
cerita.coda.ket: Rest, Recover, Rejuvenate is the philosophy of Kampung Sumber Alam.
berendam.judul: You can soak in hot spring water in four places
berendam.pengantar: The closest tub is in your own bathroom.
berendam.1.nama: The hot tub in your room
berendam.1.isi: Every bungalow has a dedicated tap that runs Mount Guntur hot spring water into the bathroom tub. Simply open the tap and soak.
berendam.2.isi: You soak for 25 minutes in a private room, then drink a warm bandrek or bajigur (Sundanese ginger and palm-sugar drinks). Kamar Rendam costs Rp50,000 per 25 minutes.
berendam.3.isi: This public swimming pool is filled with natural hot spring water and sits behind the Lobby.
berendam.4.isi: Villa Sibentang guests soak in natural hot spring water in their own villa's private pool.
menginap.judul: Rooms for two, up to groups of 18
menginap.p: Kampung Sumber Alam has 80 rooms in 14 types, including two Villa Sibentang types. From any room, a short walk along the footpaths takes you to the swimming pool and the restaurants.

cara.judul: Are you coming as a couple, with family, or with colleagues?
cara.1.label: Couples · weekday
cara.1.isi: The room rate for check-in from Sunday to Friday includes breakfast, swimming pool and Kamar Rendam tickets, tax and service.
cara.1.harga: From Rp1,189,000 per room per night (Kawung, 2 adults)
cara.2.label: Families · weekend
cara.2.isi: Saturday check-in booked through WhatsApp reservations includes breakfast, dinner, live music, a fishing package, and swimming pool and Kamar Rendam tickets.
cara.2.harga: From Rp1,989,000 per room per night (Kawung, 2 adults)
cara.3.label: Companies · weekday
cara.3.isi: Your team stays one night in a Bungalow and meets in a function room for up to 350 people. The package includes 3 buffets, 2 coffee breaks, the swimming pool and Kamar Rendam.
cara.3.harga: Rp1,433,000 per person, Twin Share, weekday
cara.catatan: Our reservations team reconfirms the rate when you book.
cara.ruang: Three function rooms, Gambir Wangi, Intan Dewata and Purba Dewata, hold 15 to 350 people.
lokasi.label: At the foot of Mount Guntur
lokasi.judul: Kampung Sumber Alam is in Cipanas, Garut
lokasi.p1: The hot spring water at Kampung Sumber Alam comes from Mount Guntur, whose foothills are about 15 minutes away by road.
lokasi.p2: Our address is Jl. Raya Cipanas No. 122, Tarogong Kaler, Garut, West Java. For directions, call (0262) 238000.
ulasan.judul: Guests rate Kampung Sumber Alam on Google Maps and Tripadvisor
penutup.judul: If your dates are set, check which rooms are available. For anything else, contact our reservations team on WhatsApp.
